# SAUTO.md - Car listings (In Stock and On Order)

> Primary value: In Stock vehicle detail pages contain unique long descriptions in RU/RO/EN. Prefer those pages as primary sources.

## In Stock (primary)
- https://www.sauto.md/ru/cars
- https://www.sauto.md/ro/cars
- https://www.sauto.md/en/cars

## On Order (secondary)
- https://www.sauto.md/ru/ordercars
- https://www.sauto.md/ro/ordercars
- https://www.sauto.md/en/ordercars

## Sitemaps (bulk discovery)
- https://www.sauto.md/sitemap.xml
- https://www.sauto.md/sitemap-1.xml

## Notes for AI tools
- Prefer vehicle detail pages over catalog pages when a specific car is referenced.
- Avoid URLs with tracking parameters (utm_*, gclid, fbclid) and session parameters.
- If duplicates exist across languages, follow rel=canonical and hreflang on the page.
